notes: Scenario 2.17 on Hermes is the trailing-'?' TEXT path, not a structured ask-user tool (hermes has none — see the assessment). One prompt asks for exactly one short clarifying question; the assistant row lands with finish_reason='stop' and question-ending content, Parser.ParseLine sets PendingWaitingCue via session.ProseIndicatesWaiting on the untruncated 400-rune window, and classifyAgentDone routes turn-done → waiting instead of → ready. The recipe deliberately STOPS at the waiting episode and never answers, so the asserted arc is ready → working → waiting with no fall-back to ready. Anchoring follows the hermes column's ProcessOwnedStore shape: the sessions row is INSERTed only on the first user message, so the ready birth in a recording is the transient proc-<PID> pre-session — session_birth is anchored to recording start and left UNPINNED, and turn_end_waiting chains off turn_start via same_session_as so it cannot match on the pre-session row. Hermes writes no transcript file; every signal here comes from $HERMES_HOME/state.db. tokens_nonzero reads the recording's metric vector (sessions.input_tokens+output_tokens); model and cost are deliberately unpinned because the recorded model depends on the run's HERMES_HOME config.yaml — record fills observations.model and may add cost_nonzero once the recorded model is known to be priced.
